control_status_meanings.failed_open: blocker triggered but the dependent claim remained admitted; candidate invalid

control_status_meanings.not_identifiable: structurally valid control cannot be constructed; dependent rung blocked without mechanism-failure inference
control_status_meanings.not_run: required control absent; dependent rung blocked
